answer: Locks are written down in lotus, expire in pulse, and umber lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 163 aliases hence needs 121 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4158 identities would post 4415 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
